title: Restore cached releases while the default registry is not provisioned
summary: `ia restore` no longer refuses with IA-DIST-ARTIFACT-UNAVAILABLE when a locked kit's only registry is the built-in default and that default serves no registry (it answers without `ia-registry.json`). Such a kit, installed from a catalog or a directory, is restored from the verified archive in the workspace cache; the result warns that no registry was asked whether it was withdrawn and names it, and `--json` lists it in `unchecked`. This is what stopped the console's upgrade recipe at its restore step. A kit that is not cached, a default registry that is failing instead of absent, and every configured registry refuse as before. `@inventarch/distribution/registry` adds `restoreWithdrawals`; `registryWithdrawals` is unchanged.
